name: nyan
label: Nyan Pink
_note: Not a brand palette. This one belongs to the nyan style and exists so that style keeps its own sky instead of wearing a customer's colours -- a rainbow trail in house cyan is not a rainbow trail. Light is dusk rather than daylight: deep enough to stay the same idea as the night scheme, light enough that dark ink still reads on it. Caution takes the trail's own amber rather than the accent, because the accent is already pink and a pink warning beside a pink brand row says nothing.
_severity: Critical stays a fire red: it is the one verdict that must not be softened into the house colour -- and on this style, not into the joke either.
